name: Master Undead Trainer
body:
Your mastery over handling unaligned undead has greeted you greater insight into training them to perform basic tasks.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Undead 11 ranks.

Benefit(s): You can train mindless unaligned undead to perform 2 tricks, rather than only 1. Undead you train retain this ability until they are trained by another character, in such a case they lose their knowledge of this additional trick.
